svg.title: DataPass MosaicStudio stack — layered architecture
svg.desc: Python computes, artifacts carry the result, Studio clients render it as static sites. DOCUMENTED from repository files (see each node). Python bridge, service and file watch are prototype branches; no deployment, authentication or hosting provider is implied.
svg.text: Python computes, artifacts carry the result, Studio clients render it as static sites.

g.title: Author → Wind model script: Run
Wind model script → Artifact writer: Rows
Jupyter & marimo → Artifact writer: Rows
Artifact writer → Artifact files: Write JSON
Wind model script → FastAPI service: Model
Artifact files → Artifact file watch: File change
FastAPI service → Wind reference page: Artifact (live)
Artifact file watch → Wind reference page: Refetch
Studio framework → Wind reference page: ArtifactSource
Wind reference page → Client build: Source
Artifact files → Client build: public/
Git repository → Studio web gate: Push / PR
Studio web gate → Client build: Runs
Client build → Static bundle: dist-clients/<id>
Static bundle → Page visitor: HTML + JS + JSON

Artifact files (Artifact files): datapass.artifact v1 JSON written to clients/<id>/public/artifacts with a manifest. Bounded: ≤ 10 000 rows, ≤ 40 columns, 1 MB. Optional Parquet sidecar for other tools; the page never reads it.
Git repository (Repository): datapass-mosaicstudio on GitHub. One branch per package; pull requests merge on green CI.
Wind model script (Producer job): Plain Python script: an illustrative Weibull AEP table (generic power curve, k = 2, no losses).
Jupyter & marimo (Notebook): The same model called from one notebook cell (Jupyter) or a slider app (marimo).
Artifact writer (Library): Standard-library helper to_artifact / write_manifest. Enforces ids, provenance and size limits early; atomic writes.

FastAPI service (API service): Prototype on 127.0.0.1:8765: GET /health, GET /artifacts/{id}, POST /compute/wind-reference. Same artifact contract; runId = hash of model version + inputs. Loopback only, no authentication.
Artifact file watch (Event stream): Dev-only Vite plugin: watches public/artifacts, dedupes by sha256 and pushes datapass:artifact-changed so pages refetch.
Studio framework (Library): src/framework: runtime, view state, blocks, renderers and ArtifactSource, which re-validates every artifact before rendering.
Wind reference page (Report): Client page with static, live-service and live-file modes over the same artifact.
Architecture atlas (Live dashboard): This client: one architecture spec rendered as a layered 3D atlas and static 2D diagrams.
Client build (Pipeline): npm run build:client -- <id> emits dist-clients/<id>: one client, its artifacts, a CSP _headers file and studio-build.json evidence.
Studio web gate (CI runner): GitHub Actions on ubuntu-latest: unit tests, build, browser tests and selected-client builds on every push and PR.
Static bundle (Static host): Any static host can serve dist-clients/<id>. Built pages keep connect-src self, so they show static artifacts unless a deployment allows a service origin.
Author (People): Runs producers locally and previews pages with npm run client:dev.
Page visitor (Browser client): Opens the static page in a browser; artifacts load same-origin and are validated client-side.
